title: tc-agent-queue
description: The work waiting for your agents, and how fast it moves: the queue, the workers, Done and Failed, and a depth chart.

jobs.description: Waiting and running jobs, plus finished ones for as long as the chart should count them

workers.description: The worker slots – their number is the concurrency

now.description: The clock in epoch ms – unset, the element keeps its own while there is work

rateLimits.description: Stretches when the provider rate-limits – while one is active the workers show as paused

paused.description: The queue is paused – no new jobs start

stepper.description: Shows a – N + stepper for the number of workers

minConcurrency.description: The fewest workers the stepper allows – its – button is disabled at this number

maxConcurrency.description: The most workers the stepper allows – its + button is disabled at this number

backpressure.description: A depth that means trouble – drawn as a dashed line on the chart; above it Waiting turns amber

range.description: How far back the chart looks, in ms

totals.description: Counts since the start, when `jobs` only holds the recent ones

openId.description: The id of the job whose card is pinned, or null

promotable.description: Shows "Move to front" in a waiting job's card

cancellable.description: Shows "Cancel" in a waiting or running job's card

heading.description: The heading at the top of the card

name.description: The queue's name, muted next to the heading

priority.description: High jumps ahead of the others, low waits behind them (default "normal")

enqueuedAt.description: When it (last) entered the queue – ms, on the same clock as `now`

startedAt.description: When a worker picked it up – clear it when the job goes back into the queue

worker.description: The id of the worker that runs it

progress.description: 0–1 while it runs – leave it out and it's estimated from `estimate`

estimate.description: How long it's expected to run, in ms

attempt.description: 1 for the first try, 2 for the first retry …

detail.description: A few muted words – the source, the target, the model

error.description: What went wrong – shown in its card

detail.description: One muted line under the name, e.g. the model or "Worker 2"

label.description: e.g. "Token limit · 2M/min" – shown with the countdown
